issues.description:
Beaconpath Technologies could not publish its launch-page update on October 1. Anika Andersson's report reached Hannah at 15:31:09 UTC. She reported production attempts at 13:42:17 and 13:49:53 UTC, both ending in Error. The intended update was still absent when she checked after the second attempt. She did not report that the existing website stopped serving.

Account: [Beaconpath Technologies](hubspot://companies/06e2f2bd-6650-5eee-982a-4892df5d340c).
Workspace: f8cc7cca-5837-5214-899f-364483925e90.
Site: debb0c71-0987-5350-b244-24b237291c4f.

The support copy of the October 1 maintenance acknowledgement, received at 12:58:41 UTC, says: “Staging validation on this launch-page site, 13:15–13:30 UTC. Expected failures during that staging check can be excluded from the exercise result.”

Support case labels: intended revision “launch-update”, failed attempts “retry-1” and “retry-2”. Recovery of the intended update has not been confirmed. Ren, what is its current state?
issues.title: Beaconpath Technologies: verify the failed launch-page update
